title: Data Nijmegen Social Assistance Experiment
descriptions: This is an anonimized version of the dataset resulting from the Nijmegen experiment with social assistance, between 2017 and 2020. In the experiment, the effects of a social assistance regime based on trust and unconditionalllity are compared to the regular Dutch social assistance regime (as regulated by the Participation Act). The dataset includes a large number of potentially relevant outcomes, including health, wellbeing, social and political trust, and work-related outcomes.
